section.title: auth-service.properties
section.codeblock: auth.signing.key=file:/etc/auth/signing.pem auth.signing.algorithm=RS256 auth.token.ttl=3600 auth.token.refresh.ttl=86400 auth.token.issuer=https://auth.example.com auth.session.enabled=true auth.session.timeout=1800 auth.ratelimit.enabled=true auth.ratelimit.requests=600 auth.ratelimit.burst=50 auth.ratelimit.window=60 db.pool.min=10 db.pool.max=200 db.pool.timeout=5000 db.schema.revision=42 db.statement.timeout=15000 http.port=8443 http.tls.enabled=true http.tls.protocol=TLSv1.2 http.tls.ciphers=default http.compression=false http.max.header.size=8192 log.level=INFO log.audit.enabled=false log.audit.retention.days=30 log.format=text cache.entry.ttl=300 cache.max.entries=10000 cache.eviction.interval=30 metrics.enabled=false metrics.port=9090 metrics.prefix=auth health.path=/healthz health.timeout=2000
